avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Strong CYP3A4 inducer reduces apalutamide plasma concentrations and efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated; use alternative mood support if needed

avoid_supplements.name: Rifampin
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potent CYP3A4 inducer significantly decreases apalutamide exposure
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concomitant use; if tuberculosis treatment required, consider alternative regimens

caution_supplements.name: Grapefruit seed extract
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential CYP3A4 inhibition may increase apalutamide levels
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for increased adverse effects; consider spacing dosing

caution_supplements.name: Saw palmetto
caution_supplements.mechanism: May have additive androgen-blocking effects; limited clinical data
caution_supplements.action: Use with caution and monitor therapeutic response

avoid_foods.name: High-fat meals (>30g fat)
avoid_foods.mechanism: Significantly increases apalutamide bioavailability and variability; may increase toxicity risk
avoid_foods.action: Take on empty stomach or with low-fat meal only

caution_foods.name: Grapefruit/grapefruit juice
caution_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition may marginally increase apalutamide exposure
caution_foods.action: Limit consumption; if used, monitor for adverse effects

monitoring_notes: Apalutamide is a CYP3A4 substrate with narrow therapeutic window; monitor for efficacy loss with enzyme inducers and toxicity with inhibitors. Screen patients for concomitant medications and supplements affecting CYP450 metabolism at baseline and with any new additions to regimen.
